blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.
blocks.zh: 互动代理人可以将经验转化为可重复使用的技能,但现有的自我发展技能库主要通过积累新知识而得到改善。 失败可能导致新的技能,而随着新证据的到来,以前储存的技能较少得到重新审视。 然而,仅凭增长并不能确保可靠性,因为在当前的任务条件下,检索到的技能可能不适用,而现有的技能可能编码错误指定的业务边界。 因此,可靠的技能演变不仅需要增加知识,还需要测试和修订已经储存的东西。 我们介绍Skill-V,一个可核查的自我发展技能库. 为了让存储的知识可以测试,我们提出代表技能作为版本的,可伪造的合同,将语义意图与可观察到的行为标准联系起来. 我们利用环境结果推动图书馆的发展。 具体来说,任务失败促使技能增加,而合同评价和任务成果之间的分歧则指导对现有技能界限的修订。 为了证实这些修订,我们要求它们保持受保护的语义限制,并满足历史重播证据上标点结果的不倒退标准。 最后,我们使用一种可适用性感知过滤器来排除被怀疑不适用于当前任务的候选人。 在整个ALFWorld和WebShop,Skill-V分别实现了95.3%和85.9%的成功率,同时保持了比面向增长的基线更紧凑的技能库. 适用性过滤减少了对技能的不正确引用,基于结果的修订在不贬低以往观察到的证据的性能的情况下纠正了特定技能界限。 这些结果表明,可靠的技能演变不仅需要积累经验:图书馆必须学会保留哪些知识,何时修订,何时应用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive agents ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Team, 2023 ; Anthropic, ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Team, 2025 ) are increasingly capable of autonomous learning, a critical step toward recursive self-improvement ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . However, retaining that experience in a form that can be reused, inspected, and corrected remains challenging ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Reinforcement learning absorbs feedback into model parameters, making individual strategies difficult to isolate or revise. External skill libraries offer a more explicit alternative. They store reusable procedural knowledge outside the policy, allowing agents to retrieve it to guide future decisions ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . Recent methods ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Vishe et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) further allow such libraries to evolve during training by distilling interaction trajectories into new skills. This turns experience into an expanding external memory, but expansion alone does not make that memory reliable.
blocks.zh: 互动代理人(OpenAI, 2023;Team, 2023;Anthropic, ;DeepSeek-AI, 2025;Team, 2025)越来越能够自主地学习,这是向递归自我改进迈出的关键一步(Liu等, 2026b; Yin等, 2025 (英语). 然而,以可以再利用、检查和纠正的形式保留这种经验仍然具有挑战性(姚等,2023;申等,2023;赵等,2024)。 加强学习将反馈吸收到模型参数中,使得个别战略难以孤立或修改. 外部技能图书馆提供了更明确的选择。 它们将可重复使用的程序知识储存在政策之外,使代理人能够检索这些知识来指导今后的决策(Wang等,2024a; 霞等,2026 (中文(简体) ). 近代方法(霞等,2026;史等,2026;维谢等,2026;欧阳等,2026;王等,2026)进一步使此类图书馆在培训期间通过将互动轨迹分解入新技能而得到发展. 这把经验变成了一个正在扩展的外在记忆,但仅扩展并不能使这种记忆变得可靠.

blocks.en: As a skill library grows, the main challenge is no longer only whether it contains enough useful strategies, but whether the strategies already stored remain valid ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Pu et al., 2026 ) . Existing self-evolving skill libraries ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) primarily improve by accumulating new content. While failures lead to new skills, previously stored skills are rarely revisited ( Figure 1 (a)). A retrieved skill may be semantically relevant yet inapplicable under the current task conditions ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . A stored skill may also encode an incorrect operational boundary that is either too broad and admits ineffective behavior, or too narrow and excludes a valid strategy. These failures stem not merely from missing knowledge, but from incorrect decisions about when existing knowledge should be trusted. Such unreliability severely limits long-term autonomous self-improvement.
blocks.zh: 随着技能图书馆的发展,主要的挑战不再仅仅是它是否包含足够的有用的策略,而是已经存储的策略是否仍然有效(Oyang等,2026;Pu等,2026. 现有的自演技能库(霞等,2026;史等,2026)主要通过积累新内容来改进. 虽然失败导致新的技能,但以前储存的技能很少被重新审视(图1(a))。 在目前的任务条件下(Chen等人,2026年;Zheng等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年),重新获得的技能可能具有明显的相关性,但不适用。 被存储的技能也可能将错误的操作边界编码为太宽并承认无效的行为,或者过于狭窄并排除有效的策略. 这些失败不仅出自于知识缺失,还出自关于何时应相信现有知识的不正确决定. 这种不可靠性严重限制了长期的自主自我改善。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of self-evolving skill library paradigms. (a) Existing methods rely on growth-oriented evolution. Failures prompt the addition of new skills, but previously stored skills are rarely questioned, which often leads to boundary conflicts. (b) Skill-V treats skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts. It adds missing skills from failures (Path 1) and revises existing operational boundaries when rubric judgments disagree with task outcomes (Path 2). Through validated revisions, the library expands its coverage while actively maintaining the reliability of stored knowledge.
blocks.zh: 图1:自演技能库范式比较. (a) 现有方法依赖以增长为导向的演变。 失败会促使新的技能被添加,但之前所储存的技能很少被质疑,这往往导致边界冲突. (b) 技能-V将技能视为可伪造的版本合同。 它增加了失败导致的缺失技能(Path 1),并在标题判断与任务结果不一致时修改了现有的业务界限(Path 2). 通过经审定的修订,图书馆扩大了覆盖面,同时积极维护所储存知识的可靠性.

blocks.en: Reliable skill evolution therefore requires more than adding new knowledge ( Liu et al., 2026c ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . An evolving library must also test whether its existing knowledge remains consistent with new experience and revise it when evidence exposes an incorrect boundary. This motivates our central question:
blocks.zh: 因此,可靠的技能演变不仅需要增加新的知识(刘等,2026c; Gou等, 2024 (英语). 不断发展的图书馆还必须检验其现有知识是否与新经验相符合,并在证据暴露出错误界限时加以修订。 这引发了我们的中心问题:

blocks.en: How can an agent expand its skill library while continuously testing and correcting the knowledge already stored?
blocks.zh: 一个代理如何在不断测试和纠正已存储的知识的同时扩展其技能库?

blocks.en: To answer this, we propose treating each skill as a versioned, falsifiable contract. In addition to semantic intent and a reusable procedure, a skill must specify its conditions of applicability and the observable behavior expected when it is followed. Interaction outcomes can then serve not only as feedback for learning how to act, but also as empirical evidence for testing what the library currently claims. For instance, a rubric that accepts a failed trajectory is likely too permissive, whereas one that rejects a successful trajectory may be too restrictive.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们提议把每种技能当作一种版本的可伪造的合同。 除了语义意图和可重复使用的程序外,技能还必须具体说明其适用条件和在遵循时预期的可观察到的行为。 这样,互动结果不仅可以用作学习如何行动的反馈,也可以作为测试图书馆目前所声称情况的经验证据。 例如,接受故障轨迹的标语可能过于宽松,而拒绝成功轨迹的标语可能限制性过强。

blocks.en: Based on this idea, we introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library for interactive agents ( Figure 1 (b)). Skill-V augments each skill with a contract that links its semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. During training, each interaction provides two complementary signals for evolution. First, task failures expose missing strategies and drive the addition of new skills. Second, rubric–outcome disagreements identify existing contracts whose boundaries require revision. Candidate revisions are committed only when they preserve the skill’s semantic identity and do not regress on previously observed evidence. Skill-V thereby expands its coverage while conservatively improving the reliability of its stored knowledge.
blocks.zh: 基于这一想法,我们引入了Skill-V,一个可核查的交互式代理自演技能库(图1(b))。 Skill-V通过将语义意图与可观察到的行为标准联系起来的合同来增强每种技能. 在训练期间,每次互动都为进化提供了两个互补信号. 第一,任务失败暴露出缺少的战略并促使增加新的技能。 第二,标题-结果分歧确定了需要修改的现有合同。 只有当候选人保留了技能的语义特性,并且不会在以前观察到的证据上倒退时,才进行候选人修改。 Skill-V因此扩大了其覆盖范围,同时保守地提高了所储存知识的可靠性.

blocks.en: Skill-V also separates semantic relevance from task applicability when using the evolved library. It first retrieves semantically related candidates and then filters skills that are confidently inapplicable to the current task. The selected skills guide the policy throughout the interaction, and the resulting trajectory and outcome provide new evidence for subsequent library evolution. This closes the loop between using stored knowledge and testing whether that knowledge should be retained, expanded, or revised. The library evolves not only by expanding its coverage, but also by making its existing knowledge more selective, correctable, and reliable.
blocks.zh: Skill-V在使用已进化库时还将语义相关性与任务可适用性区分开来. 它首先检索出与众不同的候选人,然后过滤出自信地不适用于当前任务的技能。 选定的技能在整个互动过程中指导政策,由此产生的轨迹和结果为随后的图书馆演变提供了新的证据。 这结束了使用所储存的知识与测试是否应当保留、扩大或修订这些知识之间的循环。 图书馆不仅通过扩大其覆盖面,而且通过使其现有知识更具选择性、可纠正性和可靠性来发展。

blocks.en:
We evaluate Skill-V across embodied household tasks in ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and online shopping in WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . We compare against static and growth-only skill libraries to assess overall task performance. We also analyze the effectiveness of applicability filtering and the ability of counterexample-driven revisions to correct existing skill boundaries.
Empirical results confirm that verifiable evolution yields state-of-the-art capabilities. On WebShop, Skill-V achieves a 92.5 task score and an 85.9% success rate, outperforming existing memory-augmented agents. On ALFWorld, it achieves a 95.3% success rate and solves several subtasks perfectly while requiring only a fraction of the library size demanded by accumulation-centric methods. Beyond overall success metrics, our analyses demonstrate that Skill-V effectively corrects boundary errors and mitigates the catastrophic forgetting that typically degrades lifelong learning agents.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了ALFWorld(Shridhar等,2020年)和WebShop(姚等,2022年)的网上购物。 我们与静态和仅增长技能图书馆进行比较,以评估总体任务业绩。 我们还分析适用性过滤的有效性以及反实例驱动的修订以纠正现有技能界限的能力。
经验证明,可核查的演化产生最新的能力。 在WebShop上,Skill-V达到了92.5任务分数和85.9%的成功率,表现优于已存在的内存增强代理. 在ALFWorld上,它取得了95.3%的成功率,并完美地解决了几个子任务,同时只需要以积累为中心的方法所要求的图书馆大小的一小部分. 除了总体的成功衡量标准外,我们的分析表明,技能-V系统有效地纠正了边界错误并减轻了通常会贬低终身学习人员的灾难性遗忘。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We formulate self-evolving skill learning as the joint problem of expanding knowledge coverage and maintaining the reliability of existing skills. • We introduce Skill-V, which combines versioned skill contracts, outcome-grounded skill addition and revision, evidence-preserving validation, and applicability-aware skill use. • We evaluate Skill-V on ALFWorld and WebShop, demonstrating that proactive skill maintenance achieves comparable performance, including success rates of 95.3% on ALFWorld and 85.9% on WebShop. Crucially, we show that Skill-V effectively corrects boundary errors and mitigates catastrophic forgetting while avoiding the severe library bloat that plagues accumulation-only baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: • 我们制定自我发展的技能学习办法,作为扩大知识覆盖面和维持现有技能可靠性的共同问题。 我们引进了Skill-V,它结合了版本技能合同,基于结果的技能添加和修订,保留证据的验证,以及可适用性-认识技能的使用。 我们评价了ALFWorld和WebShop上的Skill-V,表明积极主动的维持技能能取得相仿的成绩,包括ALFWorld的成功率为95.3%,WebShop的成功率为85.9%. 关键是,我们显示,Skill-V有效纠正了边界错误,减轻了灾难性的遗忘,同时避免了严重的库胸胀来折磨仅能积累的基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LLM-based agents can learn from experience by retaining trajectories, reflections, or distilled knowledge ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ) . Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) and ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) convert interaction feedback into reusable textual memory, while Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024a ) organizes experience as executable skills ( Schick et al., 2023 ) . These works establish external memory as a complement to parametric learning. Skill-V focuses on a later-stage problem of how persistent procedural knowledge should be tested and corrected after entering memory.
blocks.zh: 基于LLM的剂可以通过保留出轨,反射,或分解出的知识来从经验中学习(姚等,2023;朱等,2023;Packer等,2023.). 缩放 (Shinn等,2023年)和ExpeL(Zhao等,2024年)将交互反馈转换为可再使用的文本内存,而Voyager(Wang等,2024a)则组织经验作为可执行技能(Schick等,2023年). 这些作品将外部内存建立起来,以补充参数学. Skill-V侧重于一个后期的问题,即如何在输入内存后测试并纠正持久性的程序知识.

blocks.en: Recent methods allow skill libraries to improve through interaction and feedback ( Gou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) recursively expands a hierarchical SkillBank alongside policy learning, while Skill1 ( Shi et al., 2026 ) jointly optimizes skill selection, utilization, and distillation. Skill-R1 ( Vishe et al., 2026 ) trains a lightweight generator to iteratively revise instance-level skills for a frozen task model, whereas SkillOS ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) learns a curator that updates an external SkillRepo from delayed downstream feedback. These approaches primarily study skill acquisition, credit assignment, or curation. Skill-V instead asks whether a stored skill remains applicable and behaviorally well-specified as new evidence arrives.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法使得技能库通过互动和反馈来改进(Gou等,2024;Yang等,2024.). SkillRL(Xia等,2026.)在政策学习的同时递相扩展了分级的SkillBank,而Skill1(Shi等,2026.)联合优化了技能选择,利用和分馏. Skill-R1(Vishe等,2026年)训练出一款轻量级发电机来迭代修改被冻结的任务模型的例级技能,而SkillOS(Oyang等,2026年)则从延迟下游反馈中学习出一个更新外部SkillRepo的管理员. 这些办法主要研究技能获取、信贷分配或管理。 Skill-V则询问,随着新证据的到来,所储存的技能是否仍然适用,行为是否明确。

blocks.en: SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) treats a single skill document as a trainable parameter updated via validation-gated edits. Concurrently, SkillOps ( Pu et al., 2026 ) represents skills as typed contracts and maintains library-level utility, compatibility, risk, and validation. Skill-V differs in both its setting and learning signal. It studies skill maintenance within interactive reinforcement learning, where the policy and library evolve together. General agent reliability is often approached through post-hoc reflection or self-correction ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . Skill-V instead uses disagreements between skill rubrics and environment outcomes to systematically identify boundary errors. Candidate revisions are admitted only when they preserve semantic intent and do not regress on observed counterexamples. This strict validation is designed to mitigate the catastrophic forgetting that typically degrades lifelong learning agents ( French, 1999 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) . Thus, Skill-V extends skill evolution from acquiring more knowledge to maintaining when existing knowledge should be trusted.
blocks.zh: SkillOpt (Yang等, 2026) 将单技能文档作为可被验证-加码编辑更新的可训练参数. 同时,SkillOps(Pu等,2026年)代表了作为打字合同的技能,并保持了库级的效用,兼容性,风险和验证. Skill-V的设置和学习信号都不同. 它研究在互动强化学习中维持技能的问题,政策和图书馆在那里共同演变。 一般剂的可靠性往往通过后热反射或自修正处理(Shinn等,2023;Gou等,2024.). Skill-V则利用技能主题与环境结果之间的分歧来系统识别边界出错. 候选人修改只有在保留语义意图,并且不会在观察到的反例中倒退的情况下才被允许。 这种严格的验证旨在减轻通常会贬低终身学习代理人的灾难性遗忘(法语,1999;Wang等,2024b.). 因此,技能-V将技能演变从获得更多知识延伸到维持应信任现有知识。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Skill-V turns an external skill library into an explicit object of learning. As illustrated in Figure 2 , it forms a closed loop between skill use and library evolution. We formalize this interactive setting in Section 3.1 and represent skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts in Section 3.2 . During training, environment outcomes drive library evolution through two complementary mechanisms detailed in Section 3.3 . Task failures motivate the addition of new skills, while disagreements between contract rubrics and actual outcomes trigger targeted boundary revisions. Finally, Section 3.4 describes how the agent retrieves and filters these skills to ensure task applicability during inference.
blocks.zh: Skill-V将外部技能库转变为明确的学习对象. 如图2所示,它构成了技能使用和图书馆演变之间的密闭循环。 我们将在第3.1节中正式确立这种互动环境,并在第3.2节中以版本化、可伪造的合同形式代表技能。 在培训期间,环境结果通过第3.3节所详述的两个补充机制推动图书馆的发展。 任务失败促使增加了新的技能,而合同标题与实际结果之间的分歧触发了有针对性的边界修订。 最后,第3.4节描述了代理人如何检索和过滤这些技能,以确保在推论期间适用任务。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of Skill-V. Skill-V first retrieves and filters task-relevant skills to guide policy interaction, then uses the resulting trajectories and environment outcomes to evolve the skill library. Failures expose missing strategies and lead to the addition of new semantic skills, whereas rubric–outcome disagreements provide counterexamples for revising existing executable skill contracts. Contract revisions are committed only after deterministic validation, and the updated library is reused in future interactions.
blocks.zh: 图2: Skill-V. Skill-V的概述 首先是检索和过滤与任务相关的技能,以指导政策互动,然后利用由此产生的轨迹和环境成果来演化技能库. 失败暴露出缺少战略,导致增加新的语义技能,而最终的分歧则为修订现有的可执行技能合同提供了反例。 只有经过确定性验证后,才进行合同修改,更新后的库在未来互动中被再用.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: 3.2 Skills as Verifiable Contracts
blocks.zh: 3.2 作为可核实合同的技能

blocks.en: Skill-V represents each skill s i ∈ ℒ m s_{i}\in\mathcal{L}_{m} as s i = ( ϕ i , p i , ρ i , ν i ) , ρ i ∈ { ∅ , ( A i , 𝒞 i ) } , s_{i}=\left(\phi_{i},\,p_{i},\,\rho_{i},\,\nu_{i}\right),\qquad\rho_{i}\in\left\{\emptyset,\,(A_{i},\mathcal{C}_{i})\right\}, (2) where ϕ i \phi_{i} specifies the semantic intent and intended applicability of the skill, p i p_{i} describes its reusable procedure, and ν i \nu_{i} records its skill and rubric versions. The rubric ρ i \rho_{i} remains ∅ \emptyset while its executable specification is pending. Otherwise, it comprises applicability conditions A i A_{i} and a set of weighted behavioral criteria 𝒞 i = { c i ​ j } j \mathcal{C}_{i}=\{c_{ij}\}_{j} .

The semantic specification determines what knowledge the skill represents and how it should guide the policy. However, free-form language alone does not provide a systematic way to test whether the skill remains consistent with experience. The executable rubric therefore captures observable implications of the skill, including required steps, forbidden behaviors, preconditions, postconditions, and termination conditions. Each criterion is grounded in evidence from the task instruction, executed actions, observations, or event sequences. Some criteria are designated as hard constraints and must be satisfied regardless of the aggregate rubric score. Ultimately, these two components serve complementary roles. The semantic specification defines what the skill means, while the executable rubric makes its current operational boundary falsifiable. Skill-V can therefore revise when and how a skill should apply without silently replacing the knowledge that the skill is intended to represent.
blocks.zh: 语义规范决定了技能所代表的知识,以及它应该如何指导政策. 然而,单凭自由形式语言并不能系统地检验这种技能是否与经验一致。 因此,可执行标点抓住技能的可观察影响,包括所需步骤、被禁行为、先决条件、条件和终止条件。 每项标准都以任务指示、已执行的行动、观察或事件序列的证据为依据。 有些标准被指定为硬约束,无论总分多少,都必须满足. 归根结底,这两个组成部分的作用是相辅相成的。 语义规格定义了技能的含义,而可执行的路由则使其目前的可操作边界可被伪造. 因此,技能-V可以修改技能应用的时间和方式,而不必默默地取而代之地取而代之的是技能意在表达的知识.

blocks.en: Existing and newly added skills may initially contain only semantic descriptions and reusable procedures, resulting in ρ i = ∅ \rho_{i}=\emptyset . Such skills can already guide the policy but cannot yet participate in executable contract evaluation. Given applicable experience, a contract updater proposes observable criteria based on the interaction history. Provided this proposal preserves the skill’s semantic intent, admits non-empty executable support, and satisfies the contract specification, it becomes the first executable version of the skill. Subsequent modifications are recorded as new versions. This strict versioning makes the evolution of each skill explicit and traceable.

Alongside the aggregate judgment, Skill-V retains individual rubric scores and failed criteria to identify applicable contracts that contradict the trajectory.
Comparing rubric judgments with environment outcomes provides diagnostic evidence for skill maintenance. A rubric pass followed by task failure may indicate an overly permissive or incomplete executable specification, whereas a rubric failure on a successful trajectory may indicate an overly restrictive criterion. Agreement cases provide supporting or negative evidence, and joint failures may also motivate procedural repair. Because environment outcomes are defined for complete trajectories, these signals do not establish that a particular skill caused success or failure. Skill-V uses them to prioritize candidate updates, which are subsequently screened by the validation gate.

blocks.en: A failed trajectory may reveal that the current library lacks an appropriate strategy. To address this capability gap, a language-model updater analyzes the failed interaction to propose new procedural knowledge. The system adds this resulting skill in semantic form with its executable rubric initially pending. The skill nevertheless becomes immediately available for subsequent interactions. This proactive addition continuously expands the library’s coverage.

blocks.en: A disagreement between the rubric judgment and environment outcome provides a counterexample to the current operational boundary. Using the per-skill diagnostics, the updater proposes targeted revisions to the relevant contracts. A proposal may refine the skill’s applicability conditions, procedure, or executable criteria, but must preserve the protected semantic constraints that encode the identity of the skill. However, such counterexamples do not justify arbitrary rewrites. For each skill s i s_{i} , let ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} denote its observed evidence set, which is maintained via a bounded replay buffer of applicable trajectories. Skill-V evaluates the current rubric ρ i \rho_{i} and candidate rubric ρ i ′ \rho_{i}^{\prime} by treating rubric pass/fail as a prediction of the environment outcome. We measure their consistency using the overall disagreement rate Disc \operatorname{Disc} , the false-negative rate on successful trajectories FNR \operatorname{FNR} , and balanced accuracy BAcc \operatorname{BAcc} .

blocks.en: We require revisions to be non-regressive on observed evidence. Specifically, a candidate ρ i ′ \rho_{i}^{\prime} is considered evidence-preserving relative to ρ i \rho_{i} only if it yields a lower or equal Disc \operatorname{Disc} and FNR \operatorname{FNR} , along with an equal or higher BAcc \operatorname{BAcc} on the evidence set ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} . To be eligible for acceptance, this evidence-preserving revision must also maintain non-empty executable support, satisfy the contract specification, and preserve the semantic constraints of its source skill. Furthermore, if the revision alters a hard executable criterion, Skill-V requires a strict improvement in at least one of these three statistical metrics. An accepted revision is committed as the next version of the skill contract, whereas failing candidates are rejected to retain the current version. This rigorous constraint allows Skill-V to refine a falsified boundary without sacrificing behavior that remains supported by experience.

blocks.en: 3.4 Applicability-Aware Skill Use
blocks.zh: 3.4 适用技能 使用

blocks.en: The evolved skill library must determine which skills are useful for a particular task. Semantic similarity provides an efficient first-stage retrieval signal, but a semantically related skill may not be applicable under the current task constraints. Skill-V therefore separates candidate retrieval from applicability judgment. Given an embedding function f f , Skill-V ranks stored skills by the cosine similarity between the task embedding f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) and their semantic representations. It retrieves an expanded candidate set from both general and task-specific portions of the library, allowing the applicability stage to inspect more candidates than will eventually be provided to the policy.
blocks.zh: 进化后的技能库必须确定哪些技能对特定任务有用. 语义相似性提供了高效的第一阶段检索信号,但在目前的任务限制下,某种与语义相关的技能可能不适用. 因此,Skill-V将候选人检索与适用性判决分开。 鉴于嵌入函数 f f , Skill-V 按嵌入任务 f → (x) f (x) 及其语义表示的同位素相似性对存储技能进行排序. 它从图书馆的一般部分和具体任务部分取回了一批扩大的候选人,使适用阶段能够检查更多的候选人,而不是最终提供给政策的候选人。

blocks.en:
To evaluate task applicability, Skill-V combines deterministic contract checks with an LLM-based applicability judge. The judge inspects each candidate with respect to the current task and returns one of { Applicable , NotApplicable , Uncertain } \{\textsc{Applicable},\textsc{NotApplicable},\textsc{Uncertain}\} together with a confidence score.
Skill-V removes a candidate only when it is judged not applicable with confidence above a threshold δ \delta . This conservative rule retains uncertain but potentially useful skills while filtering confident mismatches. Among the remaining candidates, Skill-V retains those whose semantic similarity lies within a margin ϵ \epsilon of the highest-scoring candidate and selects the top K K skills. If applicability judgments are unavailable, Skill-V falls back to semantic Top- K K retrieval. The selected skills are provided to the policy at the beginning of the episode and used throughout the interaction. This execution closes the learning loop. The skill library guides the policy, the environment evaluates the resulting behavior, and the observed outcome provides new interaction evidence for adding missing skills or revising mis-specified contracts.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate Skill-V on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) using the same evaluation protocol as SkillRL and Skill1 ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . ALFWorld is a text-based embodied environment requiring agents to complete multi-step tasks. We report the overall success rate alongside success rates across its six task types (Pick, Look, Clean, Heat, Cool, and Pick2). WebShop evaluates interactive search and purchase under natural-language constraints, where we report both the average task score and success rate.
blocks.zh: 我们在ALFWorld(Shridhar等,2020年)和WebShop(姚等,2022年)上评价Skill-V,使用与SkillRL和Skill1(霞等,2026年;史等,2026年)相同的评价协议. ALFWorld是一个基于文本的包含环境,要求代理商完成多步骤的任务. 我们报告总体成功率,并报告六个任务类别(Pick、Look、Clean、Heat、Cool和Pick2)的成功率。 WebShop在自然语言的限制下评价交互搜索和购买,我们报告平均任务分数和成功率.

blocks.en: We compare Skill-V against a comprehensive suite of baselines, including closed-source LLM agents, prompting- and memory-based methods, RL-based agents, and memory-augmented RL methods. This latter category serves as our primary point of comparison and includes MemRL ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , EvolveR ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , Mem0+GRPO ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , SimpleMem+GRPO ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , RetroAgent ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and Skill1 ( Shi et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Table 1 demonstrates the strong performance of Skill-V across both interactive domains. Compared with GRPO, Skill-V improves the overall ALFWorld success rate from 77.6 % 77.6\% to 95.3 % 95.3\% , a gain of 17.7 17.7 percentage points. On WebShop, it improves the average score from 79.3 79.3 to 92.5 92.5 and the success rate from 66.1 % 66.1\% to 85.9 % 85.9\% . Since both methods optimize the policy using environment task rewards, these gains suggest that evolving reusable external knowledge provides benefits beyond pure policy optimization.
blocks.zh: 表1显示了技能-V在两个互动领域的有力表现。 与GRPO相比,Skill-V提高了ALFWorld的总体成功率,从77.6% 77.6分提高到95.3% 95.3分,增长17.7 17.7个百分点. 在WebShop上,它提高了平均分从79.3 79.3分提高到92.5 92.5分,成功率从66.1% 66.1分提高到85.9% 85.9分. 由于这两种方法都利用环境任务奖励来优化政策,这些成果表明,不断演变的可再利用的外部知识所提供的利益超出了纯粹的政策优化。

blocks.en:
As the most direct baseline, SkillRL also combines reinforcement learning with an evolving skill library. Compared to SkillRL, Skill-V elevates the overall ALFWorld success rate from 89.9 % 89.9\% to 95.3 % 95.3\% . The improvement spans several task types, including gains of 28.6 28.6 , 10.0 10.0 , 10.0 10.0 , and 5.4 5.4 percentage points on Look, Clean, Heat, and Pick2, respectively. Skill-V consequently reaches 100 % 100\% success on Look, Clean, and Heat. The gains are even larger on WebShop, where Skill-V improves the average score from 85.2 85.2 to 92.5 92.5 and the success rate from 72.7 % 72.7\% to 85.9 % 85.9\% . These results indicate that verifying skill applicability and revising existing skill boundaries provide substantial benefits beyond acquisition-based skill evolution.
Skill-V demonstrates similar superiority over more recent memory-augmented agents. It outperforms RetroAgent by 0.4 0.4 percentage points on ALFWorld, and achieves gains of 3.6 3.6 points in both average score and success rate on WebShop. While Skill-V marginally trails Skill1 by 2.2 2.2 percentage points on the overall ALFWorld metric, it achieves notable gains of 2.8 2.8 points in average score and 3.0 3.0 percentage points in success rate on WebShop.
blocks.zh:
作为最直接的基线,SkillRL还将强化学习与不断发展的技能库结合起来. 与SkillRL相比,Skill-V将ALFWorld的整体成功率从89.9% 89.9% 提升到95.3% 95.3% . 改进涉及若干任务类型,包括:在Look、Clean、Heat和Pick2上分别提高了28.6分、10.0分、10.0分、10.0分和5.4分。 因此,在Look、Clean和Heat上,Skill-V的成功率达到了100%。 在WebShop上,收益更大,Skill-V提高了平均分从85.285.2到92.592.5,成功率从72.7%72.7%到85.9%85.9%。 这些结果表明,核实技能适用性并修订现有技能界限,除了基于获取的技能演变之外,还带来大量好处。
Skill-V表现出了与较近期记忆强化剂类似的优势. 它在ALFWorld上的表现超过了RetroAgent0.4分,并在WebShop上取得了平均分和成功率的3.6分的得分. Skill-V虽然在ALFWorld总的衡量标准上略微比Skill1差了2.2个百分点,但在WebShop上取得了2.8分平均得分和3.0分成功率的显著收益.

blocks.en:
The comparison with Skill1 reveals a substantial difference in library scale. Skill1 expands its ALFWorld library to its capacity of 5,000 5{,}000 skills ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , whereas Skill-V contains approximately 200 200 stored entries at the end of training. This represents less than 4 % 4\% of the library size demanded by Skill1. Nevertheless, Skill-V achieves 100 % 100\% success on the Look, Clean, and Heat task types, outperforming Skill1 by 1.4 1.4 , 2.7 2.7 , and 0.8 0.8 percentage points, respectively. The combination of a highly compact library and superior subtask performance proves that effective skill evolution depends not only on how much knowledge is accumulated, but also on whether stored skills are strictly applicable and correctly specified.
By prioritizing verifiable maintenance over unrestrained growth, Skill-V successfully circumvents the severe knowledge bloat that typically degrades long-term agent autonomy.
blocks.zh:
与Skill1的比较表明,图书馆的规模有很大差异。 Skill1将其ALFWorld库扩展至能容纳5000个5{,}000个技能(Shi等,2026年),而Skill-V则在培训结束时包含约200个存储的条目. 这不到Skill1所要求的图书馆规模的4%。 然而,Skill-V在Look、Clean和Heat任务类型上取得了100%的100分成功,分别以1.4分、2.7分和0.8分的成绩超过了Skill1。 高度紧凑的库和优异的子任务性能的结合证明,有效的技能演化不仅取决于积累了多少知识,还取决于所储存的技能是否严格适用和正确规定.
通过将可核查的维持优先于不受限制的增长,Skill-V成功地避免了通常会降低长期剂自主性的严重知识血压。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Because the policy and skill library evolve together during training, final task performance alone cannot reveal whether the improvement is encoded in the policy parameters or maintained in the external library. We disentangle these sources by fixing the policy checkpoint at the end of training and varying only the external knowledge provided during evaluation (Table 3 ).
Without external skills, the frozen policy achieves a 78.59 % 78.59\% success rate. Providing the initial skill library raises performance to 88.99 % 88.99\% , demonstrating that external procedural knowledge remains highly useful even after extensive policy training. Using the fully evolved Skill-V library further improves success to 95.30 % 95.30\% . Unlike a library expanded through acquisition alone, this library contains newly acquired skills alongside existing contracts revised through rubric-outcome diagnosis and non-regressive validation. This additional 6.31-point gain over the initial library confirms that the evolved skill library provides useful knowledge beyond the initial library, even when the policy parameters are fixed.
blocks.zh:
由于政策和技能图书馆在培训期间共同演变,仅凭最后任务执行不能显示改进是编入政策参数,还是留在外部图书馆。 我们通过在培训结束时修补政策检查站,并只改变评价期间提供的外部知识,来分散这些来源(表3)。
没有外部技能,被冻结的政策取得了78.59%的78.59%的成功率. 提供初始技能图书馆将绩效提高到88.99% 88.99% ,表明即使在经过广泛的政策培训之后,外部程序知识仍然非常有用。 使用已充分发展起来的Skill-V图书馆,将成功率进一步提高到95.30%95.30%。 与仅通过购置而扩大的图书馆不同,该图书馆包含新获得的技能,以及经过标题-结果诊断和非后退性验证而修订的现有合同。 与初始图书馆相比,这一6.31分的额外收益证实,演化后的技能图书馆提供了初始图书馆以外的有用知识,即使政策参数是固定的.

blocks.zh: 表2:关于ALFWorld的知识源分析。 在培训结束时我们确定政策,只改变评价期间现有的外部知识。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of skill evolution mechanisms. Failure-based revision corrects permissive contracts, whereas success-based revision corrects restrictive ones.
blocks.zh: 表3:技能演变机制的差别。 基于失败的修订纠正了允许性合同,而基于成功的修订纠正了限制性合同。

blocks.en:
Adding new skills alone fails to recover the performance of the full method (Table 3 ). Specifically, the Acquisition Only variant reaches 68.8 % 68.8\% success, compared with 95.3 % 95.3\% for Skill-V. Restricting revision exclusively to failed trajectories is also insufficient, reaching only 67.2 % 67.2\% . In contrast, full Skill-V combines skill acquisition with both directions of contract correction. Failed trajectories expose missing strategies and overly permissive boundaries, while successful counterexamples identify overly restrictive boundaries. Together, these mechanisms outperform all incomplete variants by at least 21.9 21.9 points.
These results strongly support our central claim that reliable skill evolution benefits from combining library expansion with bidirectional boundary correction.
blocks.zh:
仅增加新技能无法恢复全方法的性能(表3)。 具体来说,只购买的变体成功率为68.8%,而Skill-V的成功率为95.3%。 将修订仅限于失败的轨迹也是不足的,只达到67.2%。 相比之下,完整的Skill-V结合了技能的获取和合同修正的两个方向. 失败的轨迹暴露出缺失的策略和过于放任的界限,而成功的反例则确定了过于限制性的界限. 这些机制加在一起,至少比所有不完整的变体高出21.9 21.9分。
这些结果有力地支持了我们的核心主张,即将图书馆扩展与双向边界校正相结合,有利于可靠的技能演变。

blocks.en: Table 4: Effect of the Evidence Gate on ALFWorld task performance and revision reliability. Non-regressive revisions do not worsen Disc, FNR, or BAcc on replay evidence. Passing the full gate additionally requires satisfying all remaining acceptance conditions. Regression counts are not mutually exclusive.
blocks.zh: 表4:证据门对ALFWorld任务绩效和修订可靠性的影响。 不后退修改不会使Disc,FNR或BAcc在回放证据上恶化. 此外,通过整个大门还需要满足所有剩余的接受条件。 倒退计数并非相互排斥。

blocks.en: Structural validity alone does not guarantee that a revision preserves contract reliability. Without evidence-based validation, 9 9 of the 46 46 committed revisions regress on at least one replay metric, and only 27 27 satisfy the complete acceptance criteria under retrospective evaluation. In contrast, all revisions committed by full Skill-V pass the complete gate. Consequently, enforcing this validation improves the overall task success rate from 75.0 % 75.0\% to 95.3 % 95.3\% . This substantial gain provides consistent downstream evidence that preventing unsupported revisions critically impacts library evolution.
blocks.zh: 仅凭结构有效性并不能保证修订能够维护合同的可靠性。 如果没有基于证据的验证,46个46个国家中有9个已承诺至少对一个重播指标进行订正,只有27个27个符合追溯评价中的完全接受标准。 相比之下,所有由全技能V完成的修改都通过了完整的大门. 因此,实施这一验证提高了总体任务成功率,从75.0% 75.0%提高到95.3% 95.3%。 这一巨大收益提供了一致的下游证据,防止无根据的修订对图书馆演变产生严重影响。

blocks.zh: 表5:LLM适用性法官对ALFWorld的影响。 孤立基于LLM的适用性判决的贡献.

blocks.en: Table 6: Effect of rubric-based process reward. The default policy uses only the environment task reward.
blocks.zh: 表6:基于名义的程序奖励的效果。 默认政策只使用环境任务奖励.

blocks.en: Relying solely on semantic retrieval severely limits the success rate to 71.9 % 71.9\% (Table 6 ). Retaining deterministic contract checks recovers performance to 89.1 % 89.1\% , omitting the LLM judge still drops success from the full 95.3 % 95.3\% . Throughout training, this judge labels 29.6 % 29.6\% of retrieved candidates as confidently inapplicable, confirming that semantic similarity frequently surfaces irrelevant skills that misguide the policy. These stepped ablations separate the critical contributions of both deterministic and contextual filtering.
blocks.zh: 仅仅依靠语义检索就严重限制了成功率达到71.9%的71.9%(表6)。 保留定型合同检查可以恢复到89.1%的绩效,略去LLM法官的成绩仍然低于95.3%的95.3%。 在整个培训期间,这位法官将29.6%的被检索候选人说成是自信地不适用的,证实语义相似性往往显示出不相关的技能,从而误导了政策。 这些因素使决定性过滤和背景过滤的重大贡献相分离。

blocks.en: Although Skill-V uses rubrics to diagnose and revise skill contracts, these rubrics could theoretically be converted into process rewards to directly supervise the policy. This raises the alternative hypothesis that the benefits of Skill-V stem from reward shaping rather than improved external knowledge. We examine this possibility by augmenting the default Skill-V objective with a rubric-based process reward (Table 6 ). Incorporating this dense reward yields a slightly lower success rate of 93.8 % 93.8\% , compared to 95.3 % 95.3\% for the default configuration. Consequently, we retain the simpler task-reward-only objective for our main experiments. Although process rewards might prove beneficial in other contexts, this comparison confirms that Skill-V achieves its strong performance through verifiable knowledge evolution rather than dense reward shaping.
blocks.zh: 虽然"技能-V"使用道标来诊断和修改技能合同,但这些道标理论上可以转换为流程奖励来直接监督政策. 这就提出了另一种假设,即技能-V的好处来自奖励而不是改善外部知识。 我们审查这种可能性,办法是通过基于名义的流程奖励来增加默认技能-V目标(表6)。 加上这种密集的奖励,成功率为93.8%,低于默认配置的95.3%。 因此,我们保留了我们主要实验中较简单的只获得任务报酬的目标。 虽然过程奖励在其他情况下可能证明是有益的,但这一比较证实,技能-V通过可核查的知识演化而不是密集的奖励塑造来实现其强效.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library that shifts agent learning from pure knowledge accumulation to rigorous knowledge maintenance. By representing skills as falsifiable contracts, our framework uses task failures to drive skill addition and leverages contract-environment disagreements to trigger targeted boundary revisions.
An evidence gate ensures these self-generated updates remain entirely non-regressive.
During inference, an applicability-aware filter effectively excludes confidently inapplicable candidates, preventing irrelevant skills from misguiding the policy. Empirical evaluations across ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that Skill-V achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining a highly compact library, successfully circumventing the catastrophic forgetting that plagues growth-oriented methods. As interactive agents advance toward recursive self-improvement, the ability to safely verify and correct procedural memory becomes critical. By prioritizing continuous maintenance over unrestrained expansion, Skill-V provides a principled foundation for reliable and autonomously improving agents.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Skill-V,这是一个可核查的自演技能库,将代理人学习从纯粹的知识积累转变为严格的知识维护. 通过将技能视为可伪造的合同,我们的框架利用任务失败推动技能增加,并利用合同与环境的分歧引发有针对性的边界修改。
证据门确保这些自生的更新保持完全不回溯.
在推论期间,可适用性过滤器实际上排除了自信地不适用的候选人,防止不相关的技能误导政策。 整个ALFWorld和WebShop的经验评价表明,Skill-V在保持高度紧凑的图书馆的同时,实现了最先进的性能,成功规避了困扰着以增长为导向的方法的灾难性遗忘. 随着互动代理人向递归自我改进迈进,安全核实和纠正程序内存的能力变得至关重要. 通过优先考虑持续维持和不受限制的扩展,技能-V为可靠和自主地改进代理人提供了原则基础。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations and Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录A 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Skill-V evaluates contracts using discrete text-based criteria. Applying this framework to visual or continuous control environments will require new multimodal evaluation mechanisms. Future research could integrate vision-language models to visually verify physical state changes. Alternatively, continuous environments might benefit from programmatic reward functions acting as executable rubrics.
blocks.zh: Skill-V使用单独的文本标准评价合同。 将这一框架应用于视觉或连续控制环境将需要新的多式联运评价机制。 未来的研究可以整合视觉语言模型,以视觉验证物理状态的变化。 或者,作为可执行标题的方案奖励职能可能有利于持续的环境。

blocks.en: Our framework only updates operational boundaries to prevent unintended behavior changes. If an agent initially acquires a fundamentally flawed strategy, the system will tightly restrict its use rather than discarding it entirely. Removing these inefficient strategies will therefore require additional mechanisms for explicit skill deletion. Future systems could implement automated skill deprecation to permanently retire skills that consistently fail applicability checks.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架只更新行动边界,以防止意外的行为改变. 如果一个代理最初获得一个根本有缺陷的策略,系统会严格限制其使用,而不会完全抛弃. 因此,要消除这些效率低下的战略,就需要建立其他机制,明确删除技能。 未来的系统可以对长期退休的技能实行自动化技能折旧,这些技能始终无法适用性检查。

blocks.en: The strict validation step relies heavily on past trajectories to prevent performance regression. If the underlying rules of an environment change over time, these historical trajectories may no longer represent correct behavior. Adapting this historical replay approach to rapidly changing environments remains a necessary direction for future research. Future evolution mechanisms could adopt time-weighted buffers to decay obsolete evidence.
blocks.zh: 严格的验证步骤严重依赖过去的轨迹来防止性能回归. 如果环境的基本规则随时间而变化,这些历史轨迹可能不再代表正确的行为. 使这种历史重现方式适应迅速变化的环境仍然是未来研究的必要方向。 未来的演变机制可以采用时间加权缓冲器来腐烂过时的证据。

blocks.en: Skill-V supports more transparent agent adaptation by making skill revisions explicit and checking them against observed evidence. Its contract framework could be extended to incorporate safety requirements beyond task success. Future work could develop domain-specific constraints and shared evaluation protocols to assess whether these mechanisms help detect and mitigate harmful updates, with the broader goal of enabling trustworthy recursive self-improvement.
blocks.zh: Skill-V通过明确技能修改并对照所观察到的证据加以检查,支持更加透明的剂适应. 其合同框架可以扩大,以纳入任务成功以外的安全要求。 今后的工作可以制定针对具体领域的限制和共同评价协议,以评估这些机制是否有助于发现和减少有害的更新,更广泛的目标是促进可信的自我改进。

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

blocks.en: This appendix describes the implementation of Skill-V in sufficient detail to separate the conceptual method from engineering choices. Skill-V maintains one training skill library and a synchronized evaluation copy. The training copy is updated exclusively using training trajectories. Before each validation round, the current training library is copied to the evaluation workers and remains strictly read-only throughout the validation. Rubric evaluations serve solely to diagnose and evolve the library. Unless explicitly stated otherwise, they are strictly excluded from the policy reward.
blocks.zh: 本附录充分详细地描述了Skill-V的实施,将概念方法与工程选择区分开来. Skill-V维持一个训练技能图书馆和一个同步评价副本。 培训副本仅通过培训轨迹加以更新。 在每轮论证前,将目前的培训库抄送评审工作者,在整个论证过程中严格只读. 鲁布里克评价仅有助于对图书馆进行诊断和发展。 除非另有明确声明,否则他们被严格排除在政策奖励之外。

The second revision is accepted as a non-regressive improvement, although it has not yet reached target thresholds.

blocks.en: The first revision compiles a semantic multiplicity requirement into an executable distinct-object counter. The second revision utilizes successful replay as a counterexample against an over-restrictive loop detector. These cases demonstrate that rubric evolution is not equivalent to simply accumulating constraints. Instead, it dynamically calibrates the executable boundary in either direction and commits a new version only when replay evidence proves strictly non-regressive.
blocks.zh: 第一次修订将语义上的多重要求汇编成可执行的可分辨对象计数器. 第二修订版利用成功的回放作为对照超限制性循环探测器的反例. 这些案件表明,重大演变并不等于仅仅是累积制约。 相反,它能动态地将可执行的边界向两个方向进行校正,并且只有在重放证据被严格证明是不可递归的时,它才会执行新版本.

blocks.en: The checked-in initial libraries utilize a compact sentence-rubric schema for readability. At load time, this representation is normalized into the internal criterion groups outlined in Table 7 . Each executable criterion contains a stable identifier, a description, a severity in { Hard , Soft } \{\textsc{Hard},\textsc{Soft}\} , a weight in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , a match mode in { Any , All } \{\textsc{Any},\textsc{All}\} , and at least one observable evidence matcher. Hard criteria employ unit weight. Protected semantic constraints reside within the same contract but are never treated as executable evidence unless a conservative proxy has been explicitly compiled for them.
blocks.zh: 入帐的初始图书馆采用紧凑的句子 -- -- Rubric schemea可读性。 在负载时,这种代表形式已正常化为表7所概述内部标准类别。 每个可执行标准都包含一个稳定的标识符,一个描述符,一个严重性在{硬的,软的}{textsc{Hard},\textsc{Soft}中,一个分量在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 中,一个匹配模式在 {Any, All } {textsc{Any},\textsc{All}中,以及至少一个可观察到的证据匹配者. 硬标准使用单位重量。 受保护的语义限制存在于同一个合同中,但除非为其明确编纂了一个保守的代理人,否则从未被视为可执行的证据。

blocks.en: To ensure strict security and stability, Skill-V never executes model-generated code. Evidence matchers remain restricted to a predefined declarative operator set. All domains support case-insensitive literal matching and regular expressions over the task, executed actions, environment observations, or their flattened trajectory. ALFWorld additionally supports bounded event-sequence and event-count monitors. The flattened trajectory contains only actions and observations. Policy thoughts are strictly excluded, ensuring that a planned but unexecuted action cannot fraudulently satisfy a rubric criterion.
blocks.zh: 为确保严格的安全和稳定,Skill-V从未执行模型生成的代码. 证据匹配者仍限于预先界定的申报操作员。 所有域都支持对大小写不敏感的字面匹配和对任务进行正则表达式,执行动作,环境观测,或其平坦的轨迹. ALFWorld 额外支持有界限的事件序列和事件计数显示器. 平地轨道只包含动作和观测. 政策思想被严格排除,确保有计划但未执行的行动不能以欺诈方式满足标的。

blocks.en: B.4 Failure-Driven Skill Acquisition
blocks.zh: B.4 失败驱动技能购置

blocks.en: At each library-update step, the acquisition updater receives failed training trajectories alongside the titles of existing skills. It considers at most five failure examples and retains the final five interaction steps of each example to provide context. The external language model then proposes up to a configured maximum number of reusable skills. Each proposal contains a title, principle, and intended scope. Existing titles serve as a deduplication hint, and the implementation assigns collision-free identifiers locally.
blocks.zh: 在图书馆更新的每一个步骤中,获取更新器都会与现有技能的标题一道接收失败的训练轨迹. 它最多考虑五个失败的例子,并保留每个例子的最后五个互动步骤,以提供背景。 然后,外部语言模式提出最多可配置最多可重复使用技能的数量。 每项提案都载有标题、原则和预期范围。 现有标题是一种分解提示,执行会在当地指定无相撞识别符.

blocks.en: A newly acquired skill is immediately converted into a semantic contract. Its principle serves as its initial procedure, and an immutable semantic constraint is instantiated with the status PendingCompilation . At this point, the skill can participate in embedding retrieval, applicability judgment, and policy prompting. However, it cannot produce a rubric judgment because it lacks executable criteria. This strict separation prevents an uncalibrated model-generated rule from acting as a verifier.
blocks.zh: 新获得的技能立即被转换成语义合同. 其原则是其初始程序,一个不可改变的语义限制随《待编纂状况汇编》而发生。 此时,该技能可以参与嵌入检索、适用性判断和政策提示。 然而,它不能产生一个重大判断,因为它缺乏可执行的标准。 这种严格的分离使得未校正的模型生成规则无法起到验证者的作用.

blocks.en: Pending skills receive prioritization by the contract updater. A successful compilation adds conservative executable proxies and transitions the skill into its first executable contract. A failed or rejected compilation retains the pending status, allowing the semantic skill to remain available to the policy for subsequent interactions.
blocks.zh: 合同更新员对有待更新的技能进行优先排序。 成功的汇编增加了保守的可执行代理,并将技能转换为第一个可执行合同。 失败或被拒绝的汇编保留了未决地位,使语义技能能够保留在政策中供后续互动使用。

blocks.en: The updater selects at most 12 recent cases, prioritizing the two disagreement quadrants while retaining agreement cases from both outcome classes. It then retrieves up to 24 relevant contracts to form the proposal context. Relevance favors contracts implicated by failed criteria, contracts whose semantic fields overlap the current task, and pending contracts awaiting compilation.
blocks.zh: 更新者最多选择了12起最近的案件,优先处理两个分歧四重奏,同时保留两个结果类的协议案件。 然后收回多达24个相关合同,形成建议书背景。 相关性有利于因标准失败而涉及的合同、语义领域与当前任务相重叠的合同以及待编纂的合同。

blocks.en: The external updater may refine applicability conditions, procedural steps, or executable criteria. blocks.en: C.1 Environments and Metrics

blocks.en: We evaluate Skill-V in two interactive domains. ALFWorld contains embodied household tasks and reports success rates for Pick, Look, Clean, Heat, Cool, Pick2, and the complete task set. Its binary outcome is derived from a positive terminal task reward. WebShop requires an agent to search for and purchase a product satisfying a natural-language request. We report its average task score on a 0–100 scale alongside its overall success rate. For contract diagnosis, a WebShop trajectory is labeled successful only when its normalized environment score reaches at least 0.99 0.99 .

blocks.en: All headline results in Table 1 correspond to the selected step-150 checkpoints. We deliberately avoid choosing a separate peak checkpoint for each reported metric. blocks.zh: C.3 初步技能图书馆

blocks.en: The initial ALFWorld library contains 12 general skills, 32 task-specific skills, and 11 common mistakes. The 44 general and task-specific entries function as retrievable contracts. Common mistakes are stored separately, with up to five randomly inserted into the prompt as negative guidance. The initial WebShop library contains 15 general skills, 39 task-specific skills, and 12 common mistakes. Thus, the complete initial stored-library sizes total 55 and 66 entries, respectively.
blocks.zh: 最初的ALFWorld库包含12个通才,32个任务特定技能,以及11个常见错误. 44个一般条目和具体任务条目作为可收回合同发挥作用。 常见错误单独存储,最多可有5个随机插入到提示中作为负向导. 最初的WebShop库包含15个普通技能,39个任务特定技能,以及12个常见错误. 因此,完整的初始存储-图书馆尺寸分别为55个和66个条目。

blocks.en: The initial contracts were compiled offline from previously generated procedural skills. Unsupported semantic requirements remain protected constraints but are disabled as executable proxies. This prevents the initial library from erroneously presenting a deterministic matcher as complete verification of a richer semantic claim.
blocks.zh: 最初的合同是根据以前产生的程序技能编成的。 不支持的语义要求仍然是被保护的限制,但作为可执行的代词被禁用. 这使得最初的库无法错误地提出一个决定性的比对器作为更丰富的语义主张的完整验证.

blocks.en: C.4 External Models
blocks.zh: C.4 外部模式

blocks.en: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B is utilized exclusively for semantic retrieval. The reported runs employ deepseek-v4-flash as the external language model for applicability judgment, failure-driven skill proposals, and rubric compilation or revision. The policy itself acts as a separate 7B actor and remains the only model updated by gradient-based reinforcement learning. External-model responses are parsed as JSON and verified locally. The updater structurally cannot bypass the contract validator or the evidence-preservation gate.
blocks.zh: Qune3-Embedding-0.6B专用于语义检索. 报告的运行采用深语-v4-flash作为外部语言模型,用于判断适用性、失败驱动的技能建议以及标题汇编或修订。 该政策本身作为一个单独的7B行为者,仍然是通过梯度强化学习更新的唯一模式。 外部模型响应被解析为JSON并在当地核实. 更新器在结构上无法绕过合同验证器或证据保护门.

blocks.en: The applicability judge operates under a limit of 2,048 completion tokens, two attempts, and a 30-second request timeout. A five-minute circuit-breaker cooldown avoids rapid repeated requests after service failures. Semantic acquisition and contract maintenance utilize limits of 4,096 and 8,192 completion tokens, respectively, with two parsing attempts.
blocks.zh: 适用法官在2 048个完成符、两次尝试和30秒请求超时的情况下运作。 5分钟的断路器冷却可以避免在服务故障后快速重复请求. 语义性购置和合同维护分别使用4 096和8 192个完成令牌的限度,并进行了两次解析。

blocks.en: Appendix D Library Evolution and Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录D 图书馆演变和诊断

blocks.en: D.1 Library Evolution Statistics
blocks.zh: D.1 图书馆演变统计

blocks.en: Table 11: Skill-library evolution through step 150. Total entries include common mistakes, which are stored separately from retrievable contracts.
blocks.zh: 表11:技能-图书馆通过第150步的演变. 总条目包括常见错误,这些错误与可收回合同分开存储.

blocks.en:
Table 11 reports the library state at the selected checkpoints. Because revisions replace existing versions in place, they fundamentally do not contribute to size growth.
For ALFWorld, the step-150 library contains 162 general skills, 32 task-specific skills, and 11 common mistakes. The 150-entry net growth arises entirely from newly acquired semantic skills. Ten contract revisions were successfully accepted by step 150 at update steps 5, 60, 65, 85, 120, 125, and 150. The corresponding numbers of accepted revisions were 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, and 2. This exact count is confirmed independently by both the summed training metric and the version history stored within the checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
表11报告选定检查站的图书馆状况。 由于修订取代了现有版本,它们从根本上无助于规模的增长.
对于ALFWorld,步骤-150库包含162个一般技能,32个任务特定技能,以及11个常见错误. 150人的净增长完全来自新获得的语义技能。 更新步骤5、60、65、85、120、125和150成功接受了10项合同修订。 接受的修订的相应数字为2、1、2、1、1和2。 这一准确的计数由汇总的训练指标和储存在检查站内的版本历史独立确认。

blocks.en: WebShop contains 153 stored entries at step 150 and records 14 accepted revisions. Its net growth is computed purely from the final and initial library sizes, as the revisions themselves execute as in-place updates. These robust statistics demonstrate that the reported method does far more than simply grow its library. It actively calibrates the operational boundaries of persistent skills as empirical evidence accumulates.
blocks.zh: WebShop中包含153个存储在第150步的条目,并记录了14个被接受的修订. 其净增长完全取自图书馆的最终和初始规模,因为修订本身是作为现场更新进行的。 这些可靠的统计数据表明,所报告的方法远远不止是发展图书馆。 随着经验证据的积累,它积极校正了持续技能的业务界限。

blocks.en: D.2 Checkpoint Diagnostics
blocks.zh: D.2 检查站诊断

blocks.en: The extremely low aggregate disagreement value indicates that executable rubric judgments remain highly consistent with environment outcomes at this checkpoint. This value serves a descriptive purpose rather than acting as a causal measure of policy quality, as the outcome is trajectory-level and several contracts may apply simultaneously to the same task.
blocks.zh: 极低的总的分歧值表明,可执行判决与该检查站的环境结果保持高度一致。 这一价值可起到描述作用,而不是作为政策质量的因果衡量标准,因为其结果是轨迹层面的,有些合同可能同时适用于同一任务。

blocks.en: Appendix E Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: 附录 E 提示模板

blocks.en: This section records the effective instructions supplied to the external language models. Runtime prompts dynamically substitute the task, candidate skills, trajectory cases, diagnostics, and current contracts into the bracketed fields.
blocks.zh: 本节记录提供给外语模式的有效指令. 运行时间促使动态地替代任务、候选技能、轨迹病例、诊断和当前合同进入括号内领域。

blocks.en: E.1 Applicability Judgment
blocks.zh: E.1 适用判决

blocks.en: Decide whether each candidate skill is semantically applicable to the task objective. Applicability means the skill could be useful for solving this task at some point in the episode. Judge only the task objective and declared skill scope. Do not require that a precondition already holds in the current environment state. Handle paraphrases and implied state changes. Use applicable when the skill is clearly compatible, not_applicable when it is clearly incompatible, and uncertain when compatibility cannot be established confidently. Return every supplied skill identifier exactly once as a JSON object containing the decision, confidence in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and a short analytical reason. [Input Fields] Task objective; Candidate skills (ID, Title, Principle, Scope).
blocks.zh: 决定每个候选人的技能是否完全适用于任务目标。 适用性意味着技能对于在剧集的某个时候解决这项任务可能有用. 只判断任务目标,并宣布技能范围。 不要求在目前环境状况下已经有一个先决条件。 处理解释和暗示的状态变化。 在技能明显相容时使用适用,在明显相容时不适用,在不能自信地确定相容性时则不确定。 将每个所提供的技能识别符作为包含决定的JSON对象一次完全返回,信任[0, 1] [0,1],并有一个简短的分析理由. [输入字段] 任务目标; 候选人技能(ID、标题、原则、范围)。

blocks.en: E.2 Failure-Driven Semantic Acquisition
blocks.zh: E.2 失败驱动语义采购

blocks.en: Analyze the supplied failed trajectories and suggest new skills to add to the skill library. Avoid duplicating existing skill titles. Generate between one and the configured maximum number of actionable, reusable skills that could prevent these failures. Each skill must contain a title, a brief principle, and an explicit condition describing when it should be applied. Return only a JSON object containing a skills array. [Input Fields] Failed trajectories (up to five failures, final five steps each); Existing skill titles.
blocks.zh: 分析所提供失败的轨迹,并建议增加技能库的新技能。 避免重复现有的技能头衔。 生成一个和所配置的最大可操作,可重复使用的技能数量,可以防止这些失败. 每种技能必须包含一个标题、一个简短的原则以及说明何时应用的明确条件。 只返回包含技能阵列的 JSON 对象 。 [输入场]出故障出轨(最多出5个出局,最后各出5步); 现有技能头衔.

blocks.en: E.3 Contract Compilation and Revision
blocks.zh: E.3 合同汇编和修订

blocks.en: Maintain a skill library under explicit hybrid contracts. First derive semantic constraints from the skill principle and make every constraint traceable to the procedure. Then add conservative executable proxies using safe, domain-appropriate matchers. Never claim that a proxy completely verifies a richer semantic constraint. Use rubric-fail/outcome-fail cases to repair a skill while preserving valid criteria. A rubric-pass/outcome-fail case indicates a missed failure and may require an added or conditionalized criterion. A rubric-fail/outcome-pass case indicates an over-restrictive rubric and may require narrower applicability or relaxed soft criteria. Preserve a supported contract unless repeated evidence justifies a change. For any revision, copy every protected semantic constraint exactly. Prefer revising a relevant contract over adding a duplicate. Return only JSON that perfectly follows the supplied contract schema and update limits. [Input Fields] Trajectory cases; Per-skill rubric diagnostics; Relevant existing contracts.
blocks.zh: 根据明确的混合合同维持一个技能图书馆。 首先,从技能原则中得出语义限制,使每个限制都能够追溯到程序。 然后使用安全,适合域位的匹配器添加保守可执行的代理. 永远不要声称代理完全验证了更丰富的语义约束. 使用 rubric- fail/ complete- fail 案件来修复一个技能,同时保留有效的标准 。 rumbic-ass/come-fail case表示失败,可能需要附加或有条件的标准。 划号失败/结果-通过案表明限制过大,可能需要范围更窄的适用性或放宽软标准。 保留一项有支持的合同,除非一再有证据证明有理由作出改变。 对于任何修订, 复制所有受保护的语义约束 。 优先修订相关合同而不是增加重复合同。 仅返回完全符合所提供合同计划和更新限制的JSON。 [输入字段] - 现行合同。
